summary: PSTF coverage for the host-local openclaw-soulfactory-control wrapper invoked by the Bahia OpenClaw SoulFactory sidecar.
observed_context: docs/analysis/openclaw-soulfactory-wrapper-orchestration-2026-06-11.md identifies Item 4 / bahia-7qt9 as the PSTF artifact and fixture task for the wrapper rollout.

docs/openclaw-soulfactory-control-wrapper.md specifies a stdin/stdout JSON command, environment configuration, deterministic local state layout, supported provision/persona.update/revoke behavior, and error mapping.
docs/openclaw-soulfactory-sidecar.md states the sidecar owns Nostr validation, idempotency, capability publication, and result publication while the wrapper owns only local OpenClaw runtime effects.
Closed MVP/sidecar Beads bahia-0wc4, bahia-23at, bahia-euu6, bahia-2r4y, and bahia-8ycd.4 are historical context only and are not reopened by this coverage.
intended_behavior: The wrapper accepts exactly one OpenClawControlInvocation JSON document on stdin and emits exactly one OpenClawControlOutcome JSON document on stdout with status success, rejected, or failed.

Provision validates required resolved SoulFactory params, rejects unsafe agent IDs or inline private secret material, creates deterministic workspace/state/audit files, and is idempotent for exact replays.
Provision rejects conflicting local state for the same agent with a different spec hash as duplicate_conflict without local runtime mutation.

Persona update requires existing non-revoked state, persists normalized persona data, updates generated prompt files, preserves runtime binding, and returns a warning when live OpenClaw hot reload is not confirmed.

Revoke requires existing state, records revoked audit state, preserves or deletes workspace according to delete_workspace, warns when credential revocation is requested without configured credential revocation, and replays without repeating local commands.
Non-dry-run OpenClaw commands target the configured containerized runtime and never launch persistent bare-metal gateway or agent processes.
Configured shared-runtime plugins are verified before agent mutation; missing plugins are installed from explicit sources and require a gateway restart before provisioning can be retried.
Runtime-unavailable or command-execution failures return structured outcomes and preserve audit state when a mutation was attempted.
out_of_scope: Implementing wrapper code or changing cmd/openclaw-soulfactory-control or internal/soulfactory/openclawcontrol behavior.
Changing Makefile, Dockerfile, sidecar packaging, or sidecar method advertisement files owned by sibling Item 2 / bahia-zqn9.
Adding sidecar-to-wrapper smoke tests or publishing Nostr kind 38386 results; those belong to Item 3 / bahia-j26z.
Documentation closeout, commit, or push; those belong to Item 5 / bahia-hvbs.
